decisions.decision: Becky Lantry will inquire why the property at 925 Chase Road was demolished before Historical Commission review.

decisions.decision: Becky Lantry is preparing a public notice explaining the demolition delay review plan for residential and commercial properties over seventy-five years old or of historical value.
